purpose: Teach: 洋楽/紅白/表参道/ビーズ/格言/コンテナ/ワゴン/エサ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、洋楽流してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, my shop's been playing Western music lately.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Gentle lean-in. Light, observational tone—noticing what might interest him. No pressure, just sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、紅白歌合戦見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to watch the Kohaku Uta Gassen.
lines.style: Clear, direct want. Earnest but not demanding. Small voice, genuine longing. A kid stating what matters to him without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと表参道に行ったの?
lines.en: Sho, did you go to Omotesando with your dad?
lines.style: Gentle interest. Soft curiosity—asking because she wants to know what he's been up to. Warm, attentive listening posture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ビーズで作ったブレスレット、見せたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to show you the bracelet I made with beads.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Reaching upward with the request—he made something and wants her eyes on it. Small but clear voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの格言、覚えてる?
lines.en: Sho, do you remember what Grandpa always says?
lines.style: Soft, testing question. She's checking in gently—sensing something in him that made her think of it. Curious but not probing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、コンテナでお家ごっこしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I built a house inside the storage container.
lines.style: Eager to share, eyes bright. The excited chatter of a kid with something he wants to tell. Fast, warm delivery—not breathless, just alive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭りのワゴン屋さん、好きでしょ?
lines.en: Sho, you like the festival stalls, don't you?
lines.style: Warm knowingness. A small smile in the voice—she knows he does and is inviting him to confirm it. Gentle coaxing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お庭の鳥にエサあげたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I fed the birds in the garden today.
lines.style: Soft accomplishment. Quiet satisfaction—he did something small and good and wants her to know. Close, intimate tone, like sharing a secret.
